capabilities: Set line width per note, globally, or for all notes at once
Adjust width from a status-bar slider or one-click preset pills
Persist per-note widths in frontmatter, local storage, or view-only mode
Give code blocks an independent width from prose
Trigger width changes through commands and hotkeys
extras: Requires Obsidian's "Readable line length" core setting to be enabled. The README warns the plugin writes to YAML frontmatter and advises keeping vault backups; theme compatibility is not guaranteed because themes may override the --file-line-width variable.
intentEvidence: The plugin modifies Obsidian's --file-line-width CSS variable.
problem: Obsidian's readable line length is one global setting, so users cannot give individual notes different widths.
summary: Line-width controller that sets the editor width per note, globally, or for all notes via a status-bar slider or preset pills, frontmatter, and commands.
